summary: The OSM change-file member (the bundle's osm-change-files.json and GET /api/osm/change-files, one slot) writes the lane's counts as it reads them, before any cut to fit: countries by status, countries with change files, change files and gaps recorded, newest applied time; no country code. A lane older than the run or gap table is counted apart as unknown, never 0, and a sum no country answered is unknown. K13 lists osm as a lane block (no new K id); a first slice is one country cut to completion; the KPI GET never opens the lane. Wiki follows.
